tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. Off-black in Night, so the green cards sit on it, soft sage in Day.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, drawers. Holds ink, ink-muted, brass and every *-ink role color at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the tab bar, sheets, icon buttons, tonal buttons.

tokens.name: bottle
tokens.usage: Brand bottle green, identical in both themes. Used sparingly as a feature surface: the summary card on Home, a room hero. Pair only with on-bottle and brass-on-bottle.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline between rows and around inputs.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders and section dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface. Bone in Night, green-black in Day.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Locations, metadata, helper text. 5.3:1 minimum on surface-2.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The apothecary accent: bin-tag hairlines and numbers, the location tile hover, small icons. Ornament only, never an action. Text-safe on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: brass-bright
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for brass elements.

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind brass text.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Jewel blue. The ONE interactive fill: primary buttons, selected tab, links' underline. Pair with on-sapphire.

tokens.name: sapphire-ink
tokens.usage: Sapphire as text or icon on a surface: links, active breadcrumb.

tokens.name: sapphire-tint
tokens.usage: Selected tiles and rows, the active tab; behind sapphire-ink.

tokens.name: on-sapphire
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sapphire and oxblood fills.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Destructive fill (remove item, delete location). Pair with on-sapphire.

tokens.name: oxblood-ink
tokens.usage: Low-stock and error text on surfaces.

tokens.name: oxblood-tint
tokens.usage: Behind oxblood-ink: the low-stock chip and error banner.

tokens.name: verdigris-ink
tokens.usage: Stocked / confirmed text and icons.

tokens.name: verdigris-tint
tokens.usage: Behind verdigris-ink: the stocked chip.

tokens.name: on-bottle
tokens.usage: Text on bottle (9.3:1).

tokens.name: brass-on-bottle
tokens.usage: Brass detail on bottle (5.0:1): numerals and captions on feature cards.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px, offset 2px. Never removed.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Desktop screen titles (≥960px). On phones the same heading steps down to display-xl.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Large screen titles: a room, a cabinet, an item.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings. Never item names in dense lists: those are sans.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big counts on location tiles, the stepper and summary cards. Set in Inter so counts line up with the rest of the interface.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, item names in lists, form values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status chips, tab labels. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Bin codes on tags and printed labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major sections; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large breaks.

layout.note: Widths that shape pages. Breakpoints are written into media queries as literal values (CSS variables can't be used there); these entries are the source of truth.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Small tablets and large phones in landscape: tiles grow, dock buttons size to content.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: The desktop switch: sidebar replaces the tab bar, split views go two-column, titles use display-2xl.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: gutters grow to space-12, the detail pane widens.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content beside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: pane-width
tokens.usage: Desktop detail pane in split views (440px at bp-lg).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bin tags, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, feature surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, steppers, the tab bar, icon buttons.

shadow.note: Depth is a light source from above: every raised thing has a 1px top highlight and a soft shadow below. Use these tokens; never hand-write a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, location tiles, panels: anything on surface-1.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected state of raised things, paired with a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the search field and the stepper track. Things you type into or adjust sit below the surface.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Sapphire fills only: the primary button, the add button, the selected tile's ring.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: Bottom action docks, casting upward over scrolling content.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and menus.
